# minio (`minio-minio`)

MinIO is the High Performance Object Storage solution you've been searching for! API compatible with Amazon S3, it's perfect for machine learning, analytics, and app data workloads. Easy container installation with stable podman run commands. Mac, Linux, Windows support available for simple standalone server setup. Explore further with MinIO SDKs and contribute to the MinIO Project. Get your MinIO now and revolutionize your storage game!

[Service documentation](https://docs.osaas.io/osaas.wiki/Service%3A-MinIO.html) · [Source](https://github.com/minio/minio)

## Example

```terraform
resource "osc_instance" "example" {
  service_id = "minio-minio"
  name       = "myminio"

  parameters = {
    # RootUser = "..."
  }

  sensitive_parameters = {
    RootPassword = var.root_password
  }
}
```

Commented lines are optional parameters. Values marked `"..."` need a real value. Outputs are `url`, `external_ip`, `external_port` and the raw `instance` document, see the `osc_instance` resource.

## Parameters

| Name | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `RootUser` | string | no | Choose an admin user name |
| `RootPassword` | string | no | Choose a password for admin user Pattern `^(?=.*[a-z])(?=.*[A-Z])(?=.*\d).{10,}$`. Sensitive, set it in `sensitive_parameters`. |

The instance `name` must match `^\w+$` and be unique per service within the workspace. OSC lowercases it and allows at most 20 characters.

Parameter values are strings; booleans take `"true"` or `"false"`. Reference an `osc_secret` as `osc_secret.<name>.ref` to keep a value out of the instance configuration. This page is generated from the OSC catalog; the provider validates against the live catalog when planning.
